main.py.docstring_purpose: Bootstrap all LunaWave subsystems and start the async aiohttp web server.

config.py.docstring_purpose: Load and expose all environment-based runtime configuration constants     for LunaWave, including paths, ports, and the admin password.

start.py.docstring_purpose: GUI entry point that opens the LunaWave Server Manager desktop window.

config_security.py.docstring_purpose: Handles security configurations, including admin password generation and hashing.

server/serializers.py.docstring_purpose: Convert between AppState/TrackInfo domain objects and JSON-serializable     dicts for WebSocket message payloads.

server/middleware.py.docstring_purpose: Enforce per-IP command rate limiting for WebSocket clients.

server/connection_manager.py.docstring_purpose: Manages active WebSocket connections and broadcasts events to connected clients.

server/app.py.docstring_purpose: Create and configure the aiohttp web application with all routes,     services, and EventBus listeners wired together.

server/services/broadcast_service.py.docstring_purpose: Provide typed broadcast helpers that wrap ConnectionManager to push     specific message types to all connected WebSocket clients.

server/services/stream_prefetch.py.docstring_purpose: Pre-fetch and cache the stream URL for the next track in the background     to reduce playback latency at track transitions.

server/handlers/ws_queue.py.docstring_purpose: WebSocket handler for manipulating the current playback queue.

server/handlers/ws_cache.py.docstring_purpose: WebSocket handler for managing cache queries and clearing.

server/handlers/auth.py.docstring_purpose: Handle WebSocket authentication, session token verification, and     per-IP login rate limiting.

server/handlers/http.py.docstring_purpose: Serve the SPA index, audio stream proxy, health check, and Prometheus     metrics endpoints over HTTP.

server/handlers/event_listeners.py.docstring_purpose: Subscribe to domain events from the EventBus and forward them as     WebSocket broadcasts via BroadcastService.

server/handlers/ws_playback.py.docstring_purpose: WebSocket handler for processing playback control commands.

server/handlers/ws_discovery.py.docstring_purpose: WebSocket handler for processing discovery and search commands.

server/handlers/websocket.py.docstring_purpose: Handle WebSocket connections, authenticate clients, and dispatch     incoming commands to the CommandBus after rate-limit enforcement.

server/handlers/ws_download.py.docstring_purpose: WebSocket handler for managing track download requests and status.

cache/resolver.py.docstring_purpose: Resolve the playback URI for a track using a priority-based cache     strategy: local file > cached stream URL > fresh yt-dlp extraction.

cache/db.py.docstring_purpose: Provides database caching mechanisms for quick access to frequently used data.

services/discover_service.py.docstring_purpose: Query the SQLite database to provide discover-page data: recently played     tracks, favorites, cached tracks, and featured artists/genres.

persistence/discover_repo.py.docstring_purpose: Repository for Discover-tab personalization queries: bandit-ranked     "Untuk Kamu" artists, "Belum Pernah Kamu Dengar" (unheard) artists,     genre taste spectrum, genre affinity, and artist detail lookup.

persistence/__init__.py.docstring_purpose: Database facade that aggregates all repositories into a unified data access layer.

persistence/genre_repo.py.docstring_purpose: Repository for fetching genre information and tracking genre popularity.

persistence/library_repo.py.docstring_purpose: Repository for global library operations such as fetching random songs.

persistence/session_repo.py.docstring_purpose: Manages authentication session tokens, verifying and cleaning up expired sessions.

persistence/track_repo.py.docstring_purpose: Repository for track metadata, play counts, favorites, and local file paths.

persistence/artist_repo.py.docstring_purpose: Repository for tracking artist statistics and fetching artist-specific tracks.

persistence/db.py.docstring_purpose: Manages the SQLite database connection lifecycle and initialization.

persistence/discover_enrich.py.docstring_purpose: Shared batch-enrichment helper for Discover personalization queries.     Given a list of artist rows, attach a cover thumbnail and genre tag     list to each one using two queries total for the whole batch (never     per-artist), so `discover_repo.py` doesn't run into N+1 query fan-out     when enriching a page of results.

engine/radio_engine.py.docstring_purpose: Core logic for the radio mode engine, orchestrating playback when radio is active.

engine/download_manager.py.docstring_purpose: Handle the CMD_DOWNLOAD command by downloading the current or specified     track via yt-dlp and moving it to the downloads/ folder.

engine/sleep_timer.py.docstring_purpose: Handles setting, tracking, and executing a sleep timer to stop playback     after a specified duration.

engine/command_router.py.docstring_purpose: Register all CMD_* CommandBus handlers, routing each command to the     appropriate method on PlaybackController or VolumeService.

engine/volume_service.py.docstring_purpose: Handle volume-related commands and apply the correct volume to mpv     based on the active audio output mode.

engine/queue_manager.py.docstring_purpose: Advance playback to the next track in the user queue when called by     PlaybackController at track end.

engine/playback/track_loader.py.docstring_purpose: Resolve a track URI and trigger background side-effects (sponsorblock,     lyrics fetch, play-count increment) before playback begins.

engine/playback/controller.py.docstring_purpose: Orchestrate all playback logic: track loading, queue/radio advancement,     pause/seek, and mode switching via CommandBus commands.

engine/playback/__init__.py.docstring_purpose: Re-export PlaybackController as the public interface of the playback     sub-package.

engine/playback/queue_ops.py.docstring_purpose: Manages queue operations including adding, removing, and reordering tracks.

engine/playback/mode_ops.py.docstring_purpose: Handles playback mode switches, such as toggling radio mode or SponsorBlock.

engine/playback/track_ended_ops.py.docstring_purpose: Menangani reaksi terhadap TrackEndedEvent (eof/stop/error) dan polling     durasi track yang belum diketahui. Diekstrak dari controller.py agar     file controller tetap ramping (di bawah LARGE_FILE_THRESHOLD).

engine/playback/crossfade.py.docstring_purpose: Crossfade helpers untuk transisi halus antar track via MPV volume ramping.

engine/radio/common.py.docstring_purpose: Common utilities and shared logic for the radio engine components.

engine/radio/track_interleaver.py.docstring_purpose: Interleaves tracks from different artists to create a balanced radio queue.

engine/radio/artist_bandit.py.docstring_purpose: Thompson Sampling (Beta-Bernoulli) untuk memilih artis radio berdasarkan     histori selesai/skip, dengan eksplorasi otomatis untuk artis yang     datanya masih sedikit.

engine/radio/artist_selector.py.docstring_purpose: Selects and rotates artists intelligently to maintain variety in radio mode.

engine/radio/track_filter.py.docstring_purpose: Filter candidate tracks for the radio queue to prevent duplicates,     skip recently played tracks, and limit artist dominance.

engine/radio/engine.py.docstring_purpose: Manages the state and playback progression for the radio mode feature.

engine/radio/prefetcher.py.docstring_purpose: Pre-fetches tracks asynchronously to ensure seamless transitions in radio mode.

engine/loudness/gain_calculator.py.docstring_purpose: Hitung gain (dB) yang perlu diterapkan ke sebuah track supaya loudness-nya     mendekati target, berdasarkan hasil pengukuran integrated loudness (LUFS)     dan true peak (dBTP).

engine/loudness/service.py.docstring_purpose: Orkestrasi analisis loudness: cek apakah track sudah pernah diukur,     kalau belum -> ukur via LoudnessAnalyzer lalu simpan ke DB.

engine/loudness/analyzer.py.docstring_purpose: Ukur integrated loudness (LUFS) sebuah track via satu-pass ffmpeg     `loudnorm` filter mode measure-only (tidak re-encode, tidak menyimpan file     baru).

launcher/process.py.docstring_purpose: Manage OS-level lifecycle for the LunaWave server and mpv processes     from the desktop launcher.

launcher/updater.py.docstring_purpose: Stub module reserved for future OTA update checking and release info     retrieval in the LunaWave launcher.

launcher/__main__.py.docstring_purpose: Entry point for the LunaWave launcher when executed as a package.

launcher/network.py.docstring_purpose: Provide cross-platform utilities to detect TCP port availability and     identify the PID currently occupying a port.

launcher/gui/controller.py.docstring_purpose: Controls the underlying server lifecycle from within the launcher GUI.

launcher/gui/popups.py.docstring_purpose: Helper module for displaying generic popup dialogs in the GUI.

launcher/gui/ui_builder.py.docstring_purpose: Constructs the main user interface layout and elements for the launcher.

launcher/gui/dep_checker.py.docstring_purpose: Utility to verify required system dependencies before launching the application.

launcher/gui/app.py.docstring_purpose: Provide the Tkinter-based ServerManager GUI for starting, stopping,     and monitoring the LunaWave backend server.

launcher/gui/auth_panel.py.docstring_purpose: GUI component for user authentication, password reset, and first-run setup.

data/export_to_sqlite.py.docstring_purpose: Export artist, genre, and song data from a JSON file into a SQLite DB.

core/latency_window.py.docstring_purpose: Rolling window durasi (detik) untuk menghitung percentile ke-n dari     N sample terakhir. Dipakai untuk threshold adaptif yang bereaksi ke     kondisi jaringan aktual, bukan angka statis.

core/commands.py.docstring_purpose: Defines all command constants used by the CommandBus.     Separated to allow importing without pulling in the entire CommandBus.

core/state.py.docstring_purpose: Define shared application state dataclasses, enums, and the single     mutable AppState object for LunaWave.

core/ports.py.docstring_purpose: Declare Protocol interfaces (ports) for LunaWave's hexagonal architecture.

core/observability.py.docstring_purpose: Expose Prometheus metric singletons and an OpenTelemetry tracer for     application-wide instrumentation.

core/command_bus.py.docstring_purpose: Implement a single-writer CommandBus that enforces exactly one handler     per command name and records Prometheus metrics for every execution.

core/exceptions.py.docstring_purpose: Define the custom exception hierarchy for LunaWave error conditions.

core/log_config.py.docstring_purpose: Configure structlog and stdlib logging with an async queue handler,     rotating file output, and a compact single-line renderer.

core/security.py.docstring_purpose: Provide PBKDF2-SHA256 password hashing and constant-time verification.

core/events.py.docstring_purpose: Define all typed DomainEvent dataclasses for the LunaWave event bus.

core/task_utils.py.docstring_purpose: Wrap asyncio.create_task with centralized exception handling to prevent     silent background-task crashes.

core/event_bus.py.docstring_purpose: Implement a lightweight async pub/sub EventBus that decouples modules     via typed DomainEvents, using weak references for method handlers.

adapters/ytdlp/common.py.docstring_purpose: Shared utilities and constants for yt-dlp integration.

adapters/ytdlp/__init__.py.docstring_purpose: Unified client for interacting with yt-dlp for search, extraction, and downloading.

adapters/ytdlp/searcher.py.docstring_purpose: Performs metadata extraction and search operations via yt-dlp.

adapters/ytdlp/resolver.py.docstring_purpose: Resolves direct stream URLs for tracks using yt-dlp.

adapters/ytdlp/downloader.py.docstring_purpose: Handles downloading audio streams using yt-dlp.

adapters/mpv/observer.py.docstring_purpose: Observes and dispatches asynchronous events emitted by the MPV player.

adapters/mpv/__init__.py.docstring_purpose: High-level MPV controller combining connection, IPC, and event observation.

adapters/mpv/connection.py.docstring_purpose: Manages the raw socket connection to the MPV media player.

adapters/mpv/ipc.py.docstring_purpose: Handles JSON IPC communication and command execution with MPV.

plugins/lyrics_sync.py.docstring_purpose: Synchronizes lyrics display with current track playback progress.

plugins/lyrics_fetcher.py.docstring_purpose: Fetch synchronized lyrics from lrclib.net and syncedlyrics, then     update the active lyric index on each playback progress event.

plugins/sponsorblock.py.docstring_purpose: Fetch SponsorBlock skip segments for the current video and auto-seek     past them during playback.

plugins/lyrics.py.docstring_purpose: Expose lyrics fetching, parsing, and syncing functionality.

plugins/lyrics_parser.py.docstring_purpose: Parser for extracting timed lyrics from LRC-formatted text.

plugins/notifications.py.docstring_purpose: Mirror current playback state to an Android MediaStyle notification via     termux-notification and relay button presses back via CommandBus.
